drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe, administer, and dispense drugs including controlled substances for accepted therapeutic purposes. Prescribing opioid medication is subject to limits set in section 3300-F (100 MME/day cap with exceptions for cancer, palliative care, hospice, MAT, and certain institutional settings).
drug_authority.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter and whose scope of practice includes prescribing opioid medication may not prescribe: A. To a patient any combination of opioid medication in an aggregate amount in excess of 100 morphine milligram equivalents of opioid medication per day

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates from unaccredited schools must either obtain ECFMG permanent certificate or pass the Visa Qualifying Examination (or equivalent). For postgraduate training, 36 months in ACGME-accredited program required. A waiver is available for foreign graduates who are licensed in another state and have 3+ years of clinical experience, upon board review.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Graduate from an unaccredited medical school, be evaluated by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates and receive a permanent certificate from the Educational Commission for Foreign Graduates

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: May not prescribe opioids in excess of 100 morphine milligram equivalents per day; no more than 30-day supply for chronic pain within a 30-day period; no more than 7-day supply for acute pain within 7-day period (with certain exceptions for cancer, palliative/hospice care, MAT, and institutional/surgical settings).
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter and whose scope of practice includes prescribing opioid medication may not prescribe: A. telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physician not licensed in Maine may provide consultative services through interstate telehealth if registered with the board every 2 years, fully licensed without restriction in their home state, not opening an office or meeting patients in Maine, and providing only consultative services at the request of a Maine-licensed practitioner who retains ultimate authority.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A physician not licensed to practice medicine in this State may provide consultative services through interstate telehealth to a patient located in this State if the physician is registered in accordance with subsection 3.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician associate with less than 4,000 hours of clinical practice documented to the board shall work in accordance with a collaborative agreement with an active physician that describes the physician associate's scope of practice

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician associates may prescribe and dispense prescription and legend drugs including schedule II-V controlled substances as part of their scope of practice determined by practice setting. Dispensing (other than professional samples) is limited to situations where pharmacy service is not reasonably available, is in the patient's best interest, or an emergency exists.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: a physician associate who dispenses a prescription or legend drug: A. Shall comply with all relevant federal and state laws and federal regulations and state rules; and B. May dispense the prescription or legend drug only when: (1) A pharmacy service is not reasonably available; (2) Dispensing the drug is in the best interests of the patient; or (3) An emergency exists.
